analysis: The method createBlockingHandler returns a Runnable. Inside the Runnable, it first obtains a KeycloakSession, then executes context.next() within a try block. If any Throwable (including exceptions and errors) occurs during context.next(), it is caught and a new RuntimeException wrapping the original cause is thrown. The finally block ensures the session is closed regardless. The purpose of throwing a RuntimeException is to propagate the error out of the Runnable, since Runnable.run() cannot throw checked exceptions. The programmer expects this RuntimeException to be caught by the caller of the Runnable (e.g., an executor service or framework error handler) for appropriate handling, such as logging or error response generation.
